info.name: CRM People Manager (crm-PM) API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the CRM People Manager Next.js application.

This collection covers all API routes under `app/api/**/route.ts` for the crm-PM (crm-people-manager) app, which uses Supabase for data and authentication.

## Setup
1. Set `baseUrl` to your running Next.js dev server (default: http://localhost:3001)
2. Set `supabaseUrl` and `supabaseAnonKey` from your Supabase project
3. Obtain an `authToken` via Supabase auth and set it in collection variables
4. Fill in resource IDs (`userId`, `leadId`, `candidateId`, `conversationId`) as needed
